# Fairgate Partners

> Fairgate Partners is a pay-per-call company that delivers live, inbound phone calls from homeowners to home-service companies. Buyers pay only for qualified calls.

## What we do
- Route live phone calls from homeowners who need a service to home-service companies that provide it.
- Buyers set their service area (ZIP codes), business hours, and a daily call cap.
- Buyers are billed per qualified call, based on terms agreed before calls start.
- Every call is tracked and recorded.
- Fairgate Partners does not guarantee booked jobs; buyers pay for qualified calls, not closed sales.
- Calls come from consumers who have requested service, in compliance with applicable telemarketing laws, including the TCPA.
